messages.text: hey team — flagging Associate Supply Co. heard something secondhand that their ops team has been evaluating alternatives. Vince is the owner on this one, has anyone else had any recent touchpoints with them? want to understand if this is noise or something real before I bring it up with Amy

I actually had a brief call with their IT lead two weeks ago for a support issue. nothing alarming but he was asking a lot of questions about our roadmap — specifically around integrations. felt a bit like he was pressure testing us. didn't think much of it at the time but now you mention it

I haven't had direct contact in a while tbh — Vince has been running point. but I did see that they skipped their last QBR. Vince rescheduled it twice and it still hasn't happened. that's been nagging at me

yeah the QBR thing is a flag. skipping once is one thing, twice is a pattern. Carlos — what integrations was he asking about specifically? and does anyone know if Vince has had a meaningful conversation with their economic buyer recently or has it all been at the ops level?

he was asking about their ERP system — wants tighter native sync, said their team is spending too much time on manual data reconciliation. I walked him through what's on the roadmap but he seemed skeptical on timing. re: Vince — I think it's mostly been ops level. I don't think he's had face time with their VP or above in a few months
